name: Master's Cellar
summary: Restless dead haunt Master's Cellar beneath the ruined hamlet south of Karazhan. Wine and provisions once filled its vaults for Medivh's estate; now the dead crowd its cellars and caverns.

sections.title: Haunted Underbelly of Karazhan
sections.body: South of Karazhan, ruined homes mark the hamlet where Medivh's servants, groundskeepers, and attendants once lived. Two entrances in the ruins lead beneath them into Master's Cellar. One opens into vaulted wine cellars. The other descends through broken stone into natural caverns. Whatever dark fate overtook Karazhan and its master reached the hamlet too. Caretakers, wailing spectres, and damned souls remain trapped below, bound to endless service.

sections.title: The Lower Caverns
sections.body: At the deepest reach of Master's Cellar, the Lower Cellar opens into the rock beneath Deadwind Pass. The floor and foundations crumbled into natural caverns, leaving a jagged maze where ghostly wails travel through the stone. Few living souls enter these depths. Magical corruption from the nearby tower holds the apparitions here, making the caverns perilous, much like the ruins above.

faq.q: What was the Master's Cellar originally used for?
aliases: why is there a wine cellar here
faq.answer: Master's Cellar held wine and provisions for Karazhan. The hamlet above housed Medivh's domestic staff and groundskeepers, who maintained his household and stored supplies and vintage kegs in its vaults.

faq.q: Why is the cellar full of ghosts?
aliases: who are the undead in the cellar
faq.answer: No one knows for certain what befell the hamlet. The dark fate that overtook Karazhan and its master claimed it too. Former servants and villagers now haunt the ruins as restless shades, wailing spectres, and unliving caretakers.

faq.q: How do you access the cave systems below the cellar?
aliases: how to get into the lower cellar
faq.answer: Two cellar doorways lie among the ruined buildings south of Karazhan. The eastern entrance opens into the wine cellar; the western one descends through collapsed masonry into the natural caves of the Lower Cellar.

faq.q: Is the Master's Cellar directly connected to the interior of Karazhan?
aliases: does masters cellar lead into karazhan
faq.answer: No. Master's Cellar lies near Karazhan and once supplied Medivh's estate, but its underground chambers have no open passage into the tower. They remain beneath the village ruins.

angles.text: Arcane backlash beneath Medivh's estate left ghostly remnants in the vaults. Ordinary domestic stores now hold lingering spectral energy.
The tormented spectres in the damp vaults are the souls of simple caretakers and servants. The lingering curse on Deadwind Pass denies them peace.
